name: XTR low clamp front derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed average 132.9 g for FD-M9025-L, 2×11-speed, top swing, 34.9 mm low clamp band, without S/M reducer adapters. The weight heading explicitly selects L-size band type; the mount rows distinguish the unadapted 34.9 mm band from 28.6/31.8 mm reducer configurations. Other mount variants do not inherit this weight.
